schema.title: Place a block
schema.description: Places a block under a machine name the caller chooses, in a region of a theme, with the settings its plugin takes; a machine name already in use is refused.

operation.label: Place a block
operation.description: Places a block under a machine name the caller chooses, in a region of a theme, with the settings its plugin takes; a machine name already in use is refused.

label.title: Title
label.description: The title of the block as shown to the user.

id.title: Machine name
id.description: A unique name for the placed block: lowercase letters, numbers, underscores and periods, not starting with a period.

x-portable-messages.check.drupal:Regex: The machine name may hold only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores and periods, and may not start with a period.

plugin.title: Block
plugin.description: What the block shows: a block plugin the block layout offers. A block that reads a context, such as the node of the page, is not offered yet.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: The order of the block in its region: lighter blocks are shown first.

status.description: Whether the block is shown at all.

visibility.title: Visibility
